accommodate.en: The new schedule can accommodate students with different club activities.
accommodate.zh: 新的時程可以配合參加不同社團活動的學生。

administer.en: Teachers administer the survey during the final ten minutes of class.
administer.zh: 老師在下課前最後十分鐘進行這份問卷。

aggregate.en: The report presents aggregate data from all participating schools.
aggregate.zh: 這份報告呈現所有參與學校的彙總資料。

allege.en: The article does not allege wrongdoing without reliable evidence.
allege.zh: 這篇文章不會在沒有可靠證據的情況下指控不當行為。

allocate.en: The team will allocate extra time to the most difficult section.
allocate.zh: 團隊會分配更多時間給最困難的部分。

amend.en: The committee may amend the rule after reviewing student feedback.
amend.zh: 委員會在檢視學生回饋後可能會修改規定。

analogous.en: The teacher used an analogous example to explain the new concept.
analogous.zh: 老師用一個類似的例子來說明新概念。

append.en: Please append the reference list to the end of your report.
append.zh: 請把參考資料列表附加在報告最後。

approximation.en: The first calculation is only an approximation of the actual value.
approximation.zh: 第一次計算只是實際數值的近似值。

assure.en: The teacher tried to assure students that the test instructions were clear.
assure.zh: 老師試著讓學生放心，考試說明很清楚。

attain.en: Regular practice can help students attain a higher level of fluency.
attain.zh: 規律練習能幫助學生達到更高的流利程度。

attribute.en: Researchers attribute the improvement to more consistent study habits.
attribute.zh: 研究人員把這項進步歸因於更一致的讀書習慣。

autonomous.en: The robot can perform several autonomous tasks without direct control.
autonomous.zh: 這台機器人可以在沒有直接控制下執行數項自主任務。

benchmark.en: The first test provides a benchmark for measuring later progress.
benchmark.zh: 第一次測驗提供了一個衡量後續進步的基準。

capacity.en: The new hall has enough capacity for the entire grade.
capacity.zh: 新禮堂有足夠容量容納全年級學生。

civic.en: The course encourages students to take part in civic activities.
civic.zh: 這門課鼓勵學生參與公民活動。

coincide.en: The exam date may coincide with the school sports event.
coincide.zh: 考試日期可能會和校內運動活動撞期。

commence.en: The science fair will commence after the opening ceremony ends.
commence.zh: 科展會在開幕典禮結束後開始。

compatible.en: Make sure the new file format is compatible with the school computer.
compatible.zh: 請確認新的檔案格式和學校電腦相容。

confer.en: The judges will confer before announcing the final result.
confer.zh: 評審會在公布最後結果前先討論。

conform.en: All reports must conform to the same formatting rules.
conform.zh: 所有報告都必須符合相同的格式規定。

consecutive.en: She practiced for five consecutive days before the presentation.
consecutive.zh: 她在簡報前連續練習了五天。

constrain.en: Limited space may constrain how the equipment can be arranged.
constrain.zh: 空間有限可能會限制設備的排列方式。

consult.en: Students should consult more than one source before drawing a conclusion.
consult.zh: 學生在下結論前應查閱不只一個來源。

controversy.en: The class discussed the controversy from several different viewpoints.
controversy.zh: 全班從幾個不同觀點討論這項爭議。

convene.en: The committee will convene after school to review the proposal.
convene.zh: 委員會會在放學後開會審查這項提案。

deduct.en: The teacher may deduct points for answers without supporting evidence.
deduct.zh: 答案如果沒有證據支持，老師可能會扣分。

denote.en: In this chart, a darker shade can denote a higher value.
denote.zh: 在這張圖表中，較深的色階可以表示較高的數值。

differentiate.en: Students must differentiate facts from opinions in the article.
differentiate.zh: 學生必須分辨文章中的事實與意見。

discrete.en: The experiment records several discrete stages in the process.
discrete.zh: 這項實驗記錄了過程中幾個分明的階段。

displace.en: A large object can displace more water than a small one.
displace.zh: 大型物體可以排開比小型物體更多的水。

elicit.en: The question was designed to elicit detailed responses from students.
elicit.zh: 這個問題是為了引導學生做出較詳細的回答。

encompass.en: The final project will encompass research, writing, and oral presentation skills.
encompass.zh: 期末專題會涵蓋研究、寫作與口頭簡報能力。

enforce.en: The school will enforce the new laboratory safety rule consistently.
enforce.zh: 學校會一致執行新的實驗室安全規定。

equate.en: We should not equate a high score with complete understanding.
equate.zh: 我們不應把高分直接等同於完全理解。

exemplify.en: This case helps exemplify the main idea discussed in the chapter.
exemplify.zh: 這個案例有助於具體呈現本章討論的主要概念。

exhibit.en: The sample may exhibit different colors under different lighting conditions.
exhibit.zh: 這個樣本在不同光線條件下可能呈現不同顏色。

facilitate.en: Clear instructions can facilitate cooperation during group activities.
facilitate.zh: 清楚的說明可以促進小組活動中的合作。

finite.en: The project has a finite amount of time and money available.
finite.zh: 這項專題可使用的時間與經費都是有限的。

hierarchy.en: The diagram shows the hierarchy of roles within the organization.
hierarchy.zh: 這張圖顯示組織內各角色的層級關係。

impose.en: The school may impose a limit on the number of participants.
impose.zh: 學校可能會限制參加人數。

incur.en: Late changes may incur additional costs for the event organizers.
incur.zh: 臨時更動可能會讓活動主辦單位產生額外費用。

invoke.en: The author may invoke historical examples to support the argument.
invoke.zh: 作者可能會引用歷史例子來支持論點。

likewise.en: The first group improved quickly, and the second group did likewise.
likewise.zh: 第一組進步得很快，第二組也同樣如此。

marginal.en: The second method produced only a marginal improvement in accuracy.
marginal.zh: 第二種方法在準確度上只帶來些微提升。

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding the rain, the indoor activities continued as planned.
notwithstanding.zh: 儘管下雨，室內活動仍照原定計畫進行。

offset.en: Planting more trees may help offset part of the carbon emissions.
offset.zh: 種植更多樹木可能有助於抵銷部分碳排放。

perceive.en: Different readers may perceive the character's decision in different ways.
perceive.zh: 不同讀者可能會以不同方式看待角色的決定。

precede.en: A short introduction will precede the main part of the presentation.
precede.zh: 簡短介紹會放在簡報主要內容之前。

predominant.en: Blue was the predominant color used in the final design.
predominant.zh: 藍色是最後設計中最主要使用的顏色。

prohibit.en: Laboratory rules prohibit food and drinks near the equipment.
prohibit.zh: 實驗室規定禁止在設備附近飲食。

proportion.en: A large proportion of students preferred the later start time.
proportion.zh: 相當高比例的學生偏好較晚的開始時間。

protocol.en: The research team followed the same protocol for every test.
protocol.zh: 研究團隊每次測試都遵循相同程序。

reluctant.en: Some students were reluctant to speak before they had enough preparation.
reluctant.zh: 有些學生在準備不足時不太願意發言。

replicate.en: Another class tried to replicate the experiment using the same method.
replicate.zh: 另一個班級試著用相同方法重現這項實驗。

respective.en: The two teams returned to their respective classrooms after the meeting.
respective.zh: 兩個小組在會議後回到各自的教室。

restrain.en: The barrier helps restrain movement around the fragile equipment.
restrain.zh: 這道護欄有助於限制人員在脆弱設備附近移動。

subordinate.en: The report treats design details as subordinate to safety requirements.
subordinate.zh: 這份報告把設計細節放在安全要求之後。

trigger.en: A sudden temperature change can trigger the warning system.
trigger.zh: 溫度突然改變可能會觸發警示系統。

uniform.en: The teacher used a uniform scoring standard for every group.
uniform.zh: 老師對每一組都採用一致的評分標準。

whereby.en: The school introduced a system whereby students can submit work online.
whereby.zh: 學校導入一套讓學生可以線上繳交作業的制度。
